q: Our São Bernardo truck parts plant buys renewable certificates. How do we show Scope 2?
title: São Bernardo truck parts Scope 2
short: Report two Scope 2 figures: location-based at the Brazilian grid factor, and market-based using the certificates you bought for the same period and volume. Keep the certificate retirement records. Buyers usually ask for both.
audience: Truck and bus component suppliers in São Bernardo do Campo and the ABC region

p: Units from bills times the official grid factor for the year.

ul: Certificates matched to the units and the period.
Retirement in your name, on the registry.
Any units not covered at a residual factor where one is published.

p: Put both figures side by side and say which one any target is set against.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.
